results.content: Year-ahead inflation expectations rose to 4.3% from 4.2% in July, topping the 3.4% reading recorded in February, just before the Iran conflict erupted, and coming in above every 2024 reading as well. Only 8% of consumers expect their income growth to outpace inflation in the year ahead, down from 18% in December 2024.
